description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Font' responsible for validating the CSS font shorthand property within the HTMLPurifier library. It includes methods for constructing the validator with configuration data and validating font property strings against CSS rules and keywords.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Font
classes.description: A class that validates CSS font shorthand properties, ensuring they conform to CSS standards and recognized keywords.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the validator with CSS property info extracted from the configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a font property string according to CSS rules, handling font-style, font-variant, font-weight, font-size, line-height, and font-family components.
